name: Ore Yome!?
source: In a hope to get a perfect life partner, a lonely unattractive guy employs a service that makes him a gender-swapped clone of himself. But the resulted girl doesn't share his enthusiasm. Confused and struggling with the despise for her original self, she needs to find her own place in the world.
